name: MMLongBench-Doc
intro: MMLongBench-Doc 是一个长上下文多模态文档理解基准。论文由十名专家在 135 份长篇 PDF 上复核已有题并编写新题，经三轮半自动质检形成 1,082 道题，覆盖单页、跨页和不可回答问题以及文本、表格、图表和图像证据。
org: Nanyang Technological University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, Sun Yat-sen University
build_method: 长篇PDF, 十名专家标注, 三轮半自动质检
modality: 文档, 文本, 图像, 图表, 表格
eval_feature: 长上下文, 跨页推理, 幻觉检测
build_method_en: Long PDFs, Ten-expert Annotation, Three-round Semi-automatic QC
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Cross-page Reasoning, Hallucination Detection
intro_en: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-context multimodal document-understanding benchmark. Ten experts review source questions and author new ones over 135 lengthy PDFs, then apply three rounds of semi-automatic quality control to produce 1,082 single-page, cross-page, and unanswerable questions grounded in text, tables, charts, and images.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect 76 existing and 59 new PDFs across seven types"] --> B["Train ten expert annotators and run 54 batches"]
    B --> C["Review 425 source questions and author new evidence-grounded items"]
    C --> D["Include single-page, cross-page, unanswerable, and multimodal questions"]
    D --> E["Run no-document relevance, with-document reflection, and expert cross-check QC"]
    E --> F["Assemble 1,082 questions: 184 source and 898 new"]
    F --> G["Generate free-form answers and use GPT-4o to extract short answers"]
    G --> H["Report rule-based generalized Accuracy and generalized F1"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集七种类型的76份已有与59份新PDF"] --> B["培训十名专家并执行54批标注"]
    B --> C["复核425道来源题并编写有证据的新题"]
    C --> D["纳入单页、跨页、不可回答和多模态问题"]
    D --> E["依次执行无文档必要性、带文档反思和专家交叉检查"]
    E --> F["汇总1082题：184道来源题与898道新题"]
    F --> G["生成自由文本回答并由GPT-4o抽取简短答案"]
    G --> H["报告规则计算的广义准确率和广义F1"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01523 Sections 3-4 and the official MMLongBench-Doc project. The diagram corrects the old 130-document/1,062-question summary to the paper's 135 documents and 1,082 questions; preserves the 76 existing plus 59 new documents, seven types, 47.5-page and 21,214-token averages, ten doctor/PhD annotators, 54 batches and 60-90 minutes per document, 425 existing-question review, new-question rates and evidence metadata, all three QC rounds with 94 removals/13.8% revisions/17.5% cross-check inconsistency and kappa 0.42, final 184 source plus 898 new questions and 494/365/223 type counts, GPT-4o short-answer extraction, rule-based generalized Accuracy and generalized F1, and LVLM versus OCR+LLM comparison.
